562:t_1:86.en:
$$ラルク$$
「Just because you're scared of $$あがり$$, why won't you look at me!?」

562:t_1:87.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「This happens because we were $$トップレス$$!」

562:t_1:89.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「At your age, what's all this $$バスターマシン$$ crap!? What's all this cutesy stuff!? It's ridiculous!」

562:t_1:91.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I never imagined you were so cornered...」

562:t_1:97.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Why did things turn out like this...?」

562:t_1:101.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You didn't talk back to $$ニコラ$$...」

562:t_1:102.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You didn't say, 'What do you know...? I've been through more than you could ever imagine...'」

562:t_1:104.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I can tell, somehow. After you were separated from us, you went through something terribly painful...」

562:t_1:105.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'm not the only one. $$赤木$$ and everyone in the volunteer club understand, too.」

562:t_1:106.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...Is it wrong to start over...?」

562:t_1:108.en:
$$シンジ$$
「If there's a way to go back to the past and redo everything, is it wrong to use it?」

562:t_1:109.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I understand that a way that kills people all over the world, like that man $$レナード$$'s, is wrong.」

562:t_1:110.en:
$$シンジ$$
「But if there's a way to start over without doing that, I...」

562:t_1:111.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...I don't know the answer, either.」

562:t_1:114.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Because however painful or sad it was, that time made me who I am now.」

562:t_1:115.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「So even if I regret the past or feel sad about it, I don't want to reject who I am now and return to what I was.」

562:t_1:116.en:
$$シンジ$$
「...Don't you... want to return to your original world, $$ノリコ$$?」

562:t_1:117.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'd be lying... if I said I didn't...」

562:t_1:118.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But I was prepared for it.」

562:t_1:120.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「The final battle with the $$宇宙怪獣$$ in my world... To make it succeed, Big Sis and I chose to be left behind by the flow of time.」

562:t_1:121.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「A distant future where no one remembered us... Where human civilization might not even remain...」

562:t_1:122.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「We knew that, if $$ガンバスター$$ could return to normal space, it would be a world like that. But we chose it.」

562:t_1:123.en:
$$シンジ$$
「Why would you make that choice...?」

562:t_1:124.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「To protect everyone... Because that was our mission.」

562:t_1:125.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「In the end, we came to a completely unfamiliar world instead of the distant future.」

562:t_1:127.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But, $$シンジ$$... I... don't regret it at all.」

562:t_1:128.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「I'm not trying to sound cool, but I'm... doing all I can to protect this world now, so I have no time to think about that.」

562:t_1:131.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Feelings transcend time and space... Wherever I am, however much time passes, what matters is always in my heart...」

562:t_1:132.en:
$$ノリコ$$
(Big Sis held her feelings for $$コーチ$$ in her heart and dedicated the time she could have spent with him to fighting to protect Earth...)

562:t_1:133.en:
$$ノリコ$$
($$ノリコ$$ is the same. That's why Big Sis is always with $$ノリコ$$...)

562:t_2:3.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「I never imagined that $$時空震動弾$$ would produce such a result...」

562:t_2:4.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「$c's feelings joined the $$時空震動$$ and reached the $$黒い太陽#sol$$...」

562:t_2:5.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Briefly though it was, causality in that region was utterly distorted. It became a universe where cause and effect mingled... a $$カオス・コスモス$$.」

562:t_2:6.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「What do you think will happen to them?」

562:t_2:8.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Let me change the question. What would you wish for, cursed wanderer?」

562:t_2:9.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$
「Would you wish to start over? To return to before you met those three?」

562:t_10:4.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Welcome. As the proprietor, $$ＡＧ$$, is absent today, $$Ｄトレーダー$$ will be operated through our unattended sales service.」

562:t_10:5.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Please understand that ace pilot celebrations will be postponed until another occasion.」

562:t_10:6.en:
$$高性能ＡＩ$$
「Now, please take your time and enjoy your shopping.」

563:t_000:1.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「There's no sign of extreme gravity, though...」

563:t_000:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Perhaps we should call it a dimensional boundary distortion that reached its maximum and remained fixed there.」

563:t_000:3.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Something is coming through here...」

563:t_000:4.en:
$$フェルト$$
「We haven't confirmed the first wave, but reports suggest their numbers weren't very large.」

563:t_000:5.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「So they've scattered across the $$地球圏$$.」

563:t_000:7.en:
$$ヨーコ$$
「And what's happened to all the $$トップレス$$ in the middle of this crisis?」

563:t_000:16.en:
$$チコ$$
「It's a sensitive matter. It's not for outsiders to interfere.」

563:t_000:17.en:
$$バナージ$$
「But fighting in this state...」

563:t_000:19.en:
$$クェス$$
「Isn't that a little cold, $$アムロ$$?」
